title: Clinical examination by beings

tellings.quote: And then I'm struggling to get up and I see this [music] face bending down to look into my eyes and they began a clinical examination of me.
I recall this panel coming down from somewhere above my head and it was over my chest and it basically covered my entire torso and then this blue light came straight down out of it
tellings.difference: Adds the panel coming down over his torso with blue light shining from it, and dates it to August 1976.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same onboard examination of Charlie Foltz in 1976 at Allagash that telling 6 describes.

as_told.title: Charlie's onboard examination under a blue light panel

plain: In August 1976 near Allagash, Maine, Charlie Foltz says he was taken aboard a craft. He says he struggled to get up and saw a face bending down to look into his eyes, and then the beings began a clinical examination of him. He recalls a panel coming down from above and covering his whole torso, with a blue light shining straight down from it. Foltz tells it as his own experience.
